visual_overrides.core_identity: A viscous amoeboid dungeon ooze whose defining variant behavior is splitting into separate living masses.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Two irregular low jelly masses with rounded lobes and sparse connective drips, each clearly moving independently.

scene_overrides.natural_posture: Both split halves remain fully supported by floor, stairs, or adjacent architecture while moving independently.
behavior_style: two split halves creeping around the same obstacle
separate ooze masses climbing or flowing along readable stone geometry
